# Synaps AI — Enterprise Decision Intelligence Layer & 3D Corporate Memory

> Synaps AI transforms complex document libraries into an interactive 3D Knowledge Graph, a 10-Agent AI Boardroom, and an autonomous AI COO Command Console.

## Business Overview

Synaps AI is an enterprise decision intelligence platform designed for C-Suite executives (CEOs, CFOs, CTOs, COOs, General Counsels) and operational leaders. It ingests an organization's entire document history—PDFs, Word contracts (.docx), spreadsheets (.xlsx), presentations (.pptx), emails, and images—into an interconnected 3D Corporate Memory Graph.

Unlike generic LLM chatbots that produce unverified hallucinations, Synaps AI operates as a zero-retention Data Fiduciary, providing 100% line-level source provenance and multi-tenant isolation across all organizational data.

## Key Product Modules & Features

- **3D Corporate Memory Graph**: Multi-dimensional WebGL visual graph mapping dependencies, compliance risks, and business decisions across time.
- **Multi-Agent Flight Control System**: Orchestrates 10 specialized parallel AI agent personas (Research, Finance, Legal, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Security, HR, Document, Digital Twin) collaborating in real time.
- **Collaborative AI Executive Boardroom**: Simulates live C-suite debate and consensus voting (CEO, CFO, CTO, Legal, HR) on strategic business decisions before capital commitment.
- **Executive Digital Twin OS**: War-gaming engine for stress-testing strategic scenarios, supplier delays, cost overruns, and market expansion.
- **AI COO Command Console**: Real-time executive operational briefings, health scorecards (0-100), and automated anomaly audits.
- **AI Strategy Studio**: Generates 11-stage enterprise transformation roadmaps, Red-Team AI challenges, and SWOT blueprints.
- **Prediction & Risk Center**: Automated scanner for contract expiries, missing signatures, policy conflicts, and compliance gaps.
- **Enterprise Decision Memory Engine**: Natural language search across historical corporate decisions, evaluating past precedents and lessons learned.
- **Single-Shot Multi-Format Ingestion**: Ingests PDFs, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PPTX, and scanned images up to 10GB per file.
- **Universal Export Engine**: Instant, board-ready PDF and CSV strategic report generation across all executive dashboards.

## Technical Specifications & Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, React 19.
- **Styling & Motion**: TailwindCSS, DaisyUI, GSAP (ScrollTrigger, TextPlugin), Three.js / React Three Fiber.
- **Database & Storage**: Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Storage / Supabase.
- **Security & Idempotency**: 256-Bit SSL, HMAC SHA256 Webhook Verification, Client/Server Idempotency Engine (`x-idempotency-key`).
- **Analytics & Tracking**: Microsoft Clarity, Vercel Analytics.
